question: Chandanakuda Mahotsavam' in Kerala is a festival celebrated in a _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**masjid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chandanakuda Mahotsavam** is one of the most famous and colorful Islamic festivals celebrated in the state of **Kerala**, primarily at the **Beemapally Dargah Shareef** (a **masjid**) in **Thiruvananthapuram**.
 
• The festival is held to commemorate the death anniversary of **Beema Beevi**, a woman believed to have possessed **miraculous powers**, and her son **Syedusshuhada Maheen Aboobaker**, who belonged to the family of the **Prophet Muhammad**.
 
• The name of the festival, **Chandanakudam**, literally translates to "**Sandalwood Pot**". During the celebration, pilgrims carry earthen pots smeared with **sandalwood paste** (**Chandanam**), filled with coins, and covered with incense sticks as an offering at the shrine.
 
• It is an annual event that lasts for **10 days**, occurring during the **Islamic month** of **Jamad-ul-Akhar**. The festival concludes with a grand procession and special prayers (**Dua**).
